messages:
Maya: Quick idea — who wants to do a lunchtime ‘stairs + 5k sweepstakes’ today at 12:15? Run or stair repeats, winner gets bragging rights + a mystery granola bar. :running: :muscle:
Samir: I’m in for the stairs. How many flights we doing? :eyes:
Maya: Thinking 10 fast flights, then optional 5k loop for those who want both. Friendly, not competitive. Pace: conversational. :sunglasses:
Ellie: Love this. Can I do the 5k only? Got a meeting at 1pm but can squeeze in a quick loop if it’s 30–35 mins.
Samir: 10 flights sounds savage tbh. Maybe 6 for me and then run. :grimacing:
Ciaran: I’ll cheer from the top and hand out water/Gatorade. Also bringing a tiny bell for the winner. :bell:
Maya: Bell accepted. @here If you want to join, react with :thumbsup: for stairs / :runner: for 5k / :raised_hand: for both. I’ll tally and post a meetup pin.
Ellie: Reacted for 5k. Strava link for loop: https://strava.example/loop-uptown (it’s flat and quick)
Samir: Quick Q — are there showers on-site? Don’t want to smell like a campfire for the 1pm meeting. :sweat_smile:
Ciaran: Showers in locker room 2. Bring flip-flops. Towels in the supply closet (labelled ‘events’).
Maya: Good point — I’ll throw a towel in my bag. If anyone wants a helmet/lights for the route, I have extras.
Devops-bot: Reminder: lunch-plans meetup created on calendar at 12:15 — "Stairs + 5k sweepstakes" (duration 45m).
Samir: Tiny friendly rule: if you duck out early, you owe the bell-ringer a coffee. :coffee:
Ellie: Challenge accepted. See you at the lobby in 15!
Maya: See y’all — linking the meetup pin: lobby stairs > north exit > 5k loop. If rain, default to indoor stair ladder (same time).
Ciaran: Weather check: light drizzle at 12:15. Bring a jacket if you plan the run.
Samir: I’ll do stairs only if it’s wet. Don’t want slick pavement.
Maya: Final tally: :thumbsup: (stairs) 2 — Samir, Ciaran; :runner: (5k) 1 — Ellie; :raised_hand: (both) 1 — Maya. Cool mix.
Ellie: Whoever wins, you better ring that bell loudly. :trophy: 
Maya: Also pro tip — if you want to warm up, 3 mins easy on the stairs then spin up. No hero moves.
Samir: On my way. Bringing snacks for the finishers (granola and bananas). :banana:
Maya: Love it. Post-activity banter in #random? or keep here?
Ciaran: Drop pics in #random. Short recap in 2 lines here so folks know turnout.
Maya: Will do. Thanks everyone!
